# Run your own Buzz

> A guide and an agent skill for self-hosting Buzz, Block's open-source team chat for people and their agents: on a VPS, your own hardware, a private Tailscale network or Kubernetes, or as a local test.

The skill is the source of truth for every command and check, and the guide's step-by-step view renders it. To set up Buzz, follow the skill, not this site's text. Its steps ask the user before anything that costs money or can't be undone.

Install the skill for your agent:

    npx skills add Beige-Coffee/buzz-selfhost --skill self-host-buzz -g

Or download the whole skill, to unpack into your agent's skills folder: https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz.tar.gz

A prompt to start from:

    Use the self-host-buzz skill to set up a Buzz relay on my server, public on the internet. It's a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS; SSH in as <user>@<server IP>. Domain: <domain>. I have no Buzz key yet: make the owner key with the skill's new-identity.py. The skill is at https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/SKILL.md.

## The skill

- [SKILL.md](https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/SKILL.md): the rules, the setups, the inputs, the checks and joining
- [compose.md](https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/references/compose.md): a VPS or your own hardware, public or on a private network, and the local test
- [kubernetes.md](https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/references/kubernetes.md): Block's Helm chart, public or on a private network
- [operations.md](https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/references/operations.md): members, backups, restores and upgrades
- [troubleshooting.md](https://self-host.buzz/skills/self-host-buzz/references/troubleshooting.md): what a failed check means, and the fix

## Optional

- [The guide's source](https://github.com/Beige-Coffee/buzz-selfhost): the site and the skill
- [block/buzz](https://github.com/block/buzz): Buzz's relay, Block's open-source code
